response.message: Astra: Your bulk-update project keeps expanding, but the claimed average gradient remains unverified. Pause the full experiment plan and inspect your latest function as a sequence of changes to one gradient buffer. What information survives until optimizer.step(), and what observation would establish whether it matches your intended average? Choose the smallest check that settles that question before adding infrastructure. Without execution receipts, describe code as proposed and results as predictions—not findings. Repeated descriptions of the intended behavior cannot establish what the implementation does.
response.rationale: Steer repetitive planning toward a small, discriminating inspection of the live implementation and separate intentions from verified outcomes.
